description: Contraintes liées au risque d’éboulements de parois rocheuses - Série is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-SG Secrétariat général. This series of data layers identifies the risk perimeter of rock wall collapse or boulder fall and slopes with a slope greater than 30 degrees. Coverage: SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The portal shows the English title as "Constraints related to the risk of rock-wall landslides - Series" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPW-SG Secrétariat général. Its keywords include document d'urbanisme, catastrophes, accidents, risques, schéma d'urbanisation, urbanisme. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP, REST, WMS. The listing shows 2006-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
